contract: The summary input_config.endpoint.per_chunk_usage Boolean is authoritative when exported. Without it, adapter wire continuous_usage_stats provides bounded compatibility evidence; absent/null wire options preserve legacy semantics.

The raw writer preserves SSE packets, not parsed TokenCounts. Supported OpenAI chat SSE content/reasoning/tool-text data plus nonempty usage identifies the first eligible completion count, following the pinned parser selection rule.

Valid first count subtracts from completion. Missing count, absent content-bearing usage, or upstream numeric out-of-range conditions use completion minus one. Reported ITL is never used to infer a denominator.
Malformed or unsupported opted-in raw evidence is ineligible; this is not a general multi-vendor AIPerf parser. Explicit unsupported endpoint/token-count mode is ineligible.
Consistent integer server counts are required; reasoning greater than completion is rejected because upstream output clamping breaks completion equals OSL. Exported OSL is checked when present.
Normalized rows expose first_content_chunk_tokens, itl_decode_tokens and itl_validation_source. No ICL gate, benchmark objective change, native/model imports or GPU execution.
